title: Fleet Coach (Driver In charge)
description:
1 - 3 years of experience managing blue-collar workforce,field operations,logistics,sales,or operations (Freshers also can apply) 

Onboard a minimum of 2 Delivery Executives (DEs) daily 

Must be comfortable with extensive field travel (own bike is mandatory) 

Basic MS Excel knowledge is preferred 

Good knowledge of the local geography and fluency in the local language

Key Skills: Leadership,Last Mile,Fleet,Team Leadership,Drives,Supply chain management,Logistics operations,Hub
